integrity: The finite test suite independently checks representative matrix norms and thresholds; universal and asymptotic claims are derived analytically. Classical binomial identities and Fourier diagonalization are acknowledged as prior ingredients. No claim of external certification or human verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact results are for directed cyclic shifts on \(n\ge2\) states and real orders \(0<\alpha<2\). Intermediate \(\ell^p\) operator norms and extensions to arbitrary directed graphs are not claimed. Independent mathematical and historical-priority verification has not occurred. Equivalent historical formulations remain possible.
title: Sharp endpoint norm and two stability thresholds for fractional directed-cycle differences
